prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE finished 9:16 portrait background texture for a bright, funny, premium mobile stacking game's HOME screen. ENVIRONMENT ONLY, no UI. It must look like colorful energetic casual-game KEY ART.

Visual style: high-quality 2.5D illustrated modern city with vivid clean colors, readable crafted depth, confident chunky architectural shapes and playful irregular proportions. This is a fantastic MODERN CITY of bright BLUE, SUNFLOWER YELLOW and CORAL apartment towers and little block buildings, modern flat rooftops, a few simple rooftop water tanks, bold inset square windows, small graphic green tree canopies. Layer MANY distinct tower silhouettes and heights with a vertical climbing rhythm along the sides. A few facades subtly slant or step in unexpectedly; narrow tall blue towers mixed with lower fat yellow blocks and orange stepped rooftops. There should be charming variety and surprise in the silhouettes. Smooth finished surfaces with crisp broad shading and selective highlights, no photographic reflections, no visible paint flecks or gritty masonry. Polished entertaining game illustration, cheerful daylight.

Composition: a dynamically framed almost upward-looking city that rises around a separately inserted object tower. Asymmetrical left/right silhouettes and multiple overlapping depth layers. NO orderly street corridor. NO road that converges into the distance. No matching near-side buildings. City architecture fills the left and right thirds mainly from 30% to 92% down the canvas, with playful staggered skyline starting higher at a few edges. Keep central 34% relatively open and lower contrast so a separate object tower fits, sky between buildings. The tallest framing buildings are near the edges, the central distant skyline is lower and smaller. Upper 28% mainly saturated cheerful sky blue for an overlaid blue/yellow logo. Final bottom 8–10% a simple matte warm pale ground terrace with just broad color shading for an overlaid game button and small separate platform. NO expansive golden plaza. This is a city built to look up and stack, not walk down a road.

Color: bright cyan-blue sky, yellow/coral/blue buildings interleaved, fresh green foliage, luminous clear colors and lighter distant city. Scene should feel lively and a little absurd while remaining visually ordered around the central playable theme. Richness comes from shape/color/depth, not small high-frequency detail. Maintain materially finished volume, without product-photography realism.

Hard constraints: NO European/Italian/Mediterranean/vacation architecture, no arches, aqueducts, churches, domes, ornate balconies, vines or cypress trees. No Renaissance illustration. NO clouds or cloud-like fog anywhere (separate clouds will be animated). No people, characters, faces, animals, toy/game objects, floating props, airships, logo, words, signs with text, buttons, counters, border, phone mockup, watermark. NO central landmark. NO prebuilt object tower or platform. Full bleed finished game background asset.

rejected.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one finished portrait full-bleed 9:16 mobile game HOME background texture, with NO interface baked in.

Primary request: a lively, surprising, joyful city that invites players to stack all sorts of unrelated objects toward the sky. The visual direction is a colorful richly crafted 2.5D casual stacking game poster. Preserve polished material depth and appealing lighting while making the environment playful through eclectic shapes, irregular rhythm, and vertical energy. Do NOT turn everything into the same rounded toy, baby cartoon, or realistic orderly street.

Composition: a slight upward-looking view from ground level, colorful mid-rise and tall narrow buildings overlapping in a charming irregular staircase up the LEFT and RIGHT edges. Vary heights, widths, roof forms and silhouettes: sunny yellow, warm peach/coral, bright sky blue facades mixed with small green trees. Neither symmetry nor matching pair of large foreground buildings. Use a few intriguing but coherent rooftop details such as a tiny water tank, a curved awning, a stepped roof and one simple round observation dome. Layer foreground side buildings, middle silhouettes and lighter distant city so the town feels bigger than this frame and keeps climbing upward. Architectural colors are vivid but the overall background contrast is lower than a foreground hero would have. Buildings have clean handcrafted dimension, distinct surface character, precise silhouettes, cheerful broad lighting, concise details, not generic clay blobs.

Reserve readable vivid cyan-to-blue sky in the upper 27 percent for a separately overlaid large blue-yellow game logo. Keep the CENTRAL approximately 36 percent of the image from y=35% to y=83% relatively open and low-detail for a separately rendered stack of objects. This open area should feel like open air within a layered city, NOT the mouth of a straight road. The city fills the lateral mid and lower frame more richly than a bare symmetrical plaza, but never puts a landmark in the central hero position. The bottom 10–13 percent is a simple unmistakable matte warm ground terrace for a separately rendered small starting platform and button. No deep road vanishing point, no strong perspective tile grid, no glossy paving or long realistic cast shadows. A few broad ground color planes are enough. No pedestal baked in.

Light/mood: sunny, fresh, optimistic, energetic, like an entertaining game invitation. Clean soft upper-left light, attractive local shading, saturated cyan-blue / yellow / coral / fresh-green rhythm. Avoid cinematic beige grading, lens effects, photography, physically rendered product-catalog styling, a sleepy luxury promenade, tiny repetitive windows, grunge or dense texture noise.

Layer constraints: sky must be CLOUD-FREE because clouds will be animated as separate sprite layers. No clouds, fog patches, balloon, aircraft, floating islands, planets, characters, people, faces, stacked toys, game items, logo, text, signage lettering, UI, frame, watermark. Only the finished sky, colorful upward-rising asymmetrical city and shallow ground terrace. This is a usable production background asset, not a screenshot or a concept board.
